This fixture exercises dependency-free Markdown table display. The captioned
computational table is referenced as @tbl-uv-python-fruit.

```{python}
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown

display(Markdown("""
| metric | value |
| --- | ---: |
| explicit markdown table | 1 |
"""))
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-uv-python-fruit
#| tbl-cap: Fruit counts from explicit Markdown
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown

display(Markdown("""
| fruit | count |
| --- | ---: |
| apples | 3 |
| oranges | 5 |
"""))

display(Markdown("""
TRAILING_PROSE_AFTER_CAPTIONED_TABLE_EVENT outside caption.
"""))
```

No pandas, polars, or tabulate dependency is required for this fixture.
